issues.description: Default speaker mismatch between docstring/PR description and config
issues.detail: PR description and class docstring say bulbul:v3-beta default speaker is 'aditya', but TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh'. That is value vs. documented-value complecting: the same fact lives in two places and they disagree. Pick one source of truth (the config table) and let docs read from it.

issues.description: Silent pace clamping hides an essential fact from the caller
issues.detail: Automatic clamping when pace is outside v3 range conflates 'value the user gave' with 'value we will send.' The caller's identity (what they asked for) is silently overwritten by a different value. Prefer raising or at minimum returning the corrected value via the API, not log-and-mutate. Right now this is EASY-NOT-SIMPLE.

issues.description: Enums duplicate the speaker facts already in TTSModelConfig
issues.detail: SarvamTTSSpeakerV2 / V3 enums and TTSModelConfig.speakers carry the same data shaped two ways, then speakers is derived from the enum. The enum is the easy/familiar OO pattern; the value is just a set of strings. One immutable mapping {model: frozenset(speakers)} would be simpler. Currently mildly COMPLECTED, not harmful.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model falls back to v2 silently for unknown models
issues.detail: Unknown model -> 'pretend you are v2' is place-oriented thinking: returning a plausible value rather than the truth (we don't know). Return [] or raise. Otherwise callers downstream will believe a fact that isn't true, and the bug will surface far from the cause.

issues.description: Removed input_audio_codec from STT connect_kwargs without explanation
issues.detail: The diff drops 'input_audio_codec' from connect_kwargs but the field is still stored on the instance and documented. Either it's now dead state (incidental) or it's a silently-changed wire contract for saarika:v2.5. Name which one; do not leave a value with no time/identity story.

review.summary: The refactor is a real step toward SIMPLE: model-specific branching (`"saaras" in model.lower()`) is replaced by a single immutable MODEL_CONFIGS table, and validation reads from that table. That is the right direction — values describing the model, functions consuming the values. The remaining issues are mostly incidental complexity creeping back in: the same facts described twice (enums + config, docstring + config) with the duplicates already disagreeing on the v3 default speaker, and a couple of silent mutations (pace clamping, unknown-model speaker fallback) that complect 'what the caller said' with 'what we did.' Fix the duplication by making the config the single source of truth, and make the silent corrections explicit. The question that should have been asked first: 'what are the facts about a Sarvam model, and where do they live?' — the PR answers it, then partially re-complects the answer.
